06/ 14.08.2024 I.A. No.7249 of 2024 This Interlocutory Application has been filed by the appellant
praying therein to suspend the sentence and release him on bail during pendency of this appeal.
2.  The appellant has been convicted and sentenced in connection with Sessions Trial Case No.85 of 2021.
He has been convicted for the offence under Section 376 of the IPC and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment 15 years with a fine of Rs.50,000/-.
3. Heard, learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.P.P. for the State and have gone through the impugned judgment, the evidence and the Trial Court Records.
4. Opportunity was given to the State to oppose the bail, which the State availed and opposed.
5. The victim is a major.
She states that when she was going in search of her husband, this appellant caught hold of her and committed rape upon her.
She also states that her 9 months old child was also in her lap when the incident had taken place.
6. When we go through the medical evidence, we find that the Doctor did not find any sign of force or assault.
He has not specifically stated that rape has been committed, rather only stated that the sexual assault cannot be ruled out but he did not find any scratches or abrasion on the body of the victim.
7. Considering the aforesaid fact, we are inclined to release this appellant on bail.
